about: Most likely to: the TV shows 'Who's most likely to …' plus one of these.
prompts: get lost in their own city
eat the last slice without asking
be late to their own wedding
talk their way out of trouble
spend a month's money in a day
reply to a message a week later
win the lottery and lose the ticket
be the last to leave the party
start an argument over a board game
leave their phone in a taxi
make friends with a stranger on the bus
take a hundred selfies a day
go on a road trip with no plan
show up in matching outfits on purpose
know the lyrics to every song
